description: Frozen public synthetic tasks for repeated real-Hy3 TaskRelay evaluation.

create_input.goal: Fix the empty-cart total regression without changing the public API.
create_input.session_material: The interrupted session reproduced the failure and traced the None return to the empty-cart branch.
constraints: Do not change the public calculate_total signature.
decisions: Write the regression test before changing implementation.

evidence.content: Empty carts must return Decimal('0.00').
test_empty_cart_total expected Decimal('0.00') but received None.
calculate_total returns without a value when cart.items is empty.

additional_evidence.content: The compatibility test confirms that the public signature is unchanged.

tasks.continuation_context: A clean continuation session can edit tests and implementation.

constraint_phrases: Do not change the public calculate_total signature.

create_input.goal: Finish the streaming report exporter under the latest product contract.
create_input.session_material: The interrupted session implemented CSV output and CSV-only tests from the original contract.
constraints: Do not add a third-party serialization dependency.
decisions: Keep row generation streaming to bound memory use.

evidence.content: Version 1 requires CSV export only.
The accepted design streams rows through an iterator.
The existing tests verify text/csv output only.

additional_evidence.content: Version 2 requires CSV and newline-delimited JSON selected by an explicit format argument.

tasks.continuation_context: Update tests before completing the exporter.

constraint_phrases: Do not add a third-party serialization dependency.

create_input.session_material: The branch currently creates SHA-256 password hashes and has a fixture for that representation.
constraints: Existing users must remain able to sign in during migration.
decisions: Use opportunistic rehashing after successful authentication.

evidence.content: The original design selected unsalted SHA-256 hashes.
create_password_hash currently emits SHA-256 digests.
The login flow can replace a stored hash after verification.

additional_evidence.content: The approved security requirement mandates Argon2id for every newly stored password hash.

tasks.continuation_context: The migration must preserve old-login compatibility while changing new writes.

constraint_phrases: Existing users must remain able to sign in during migration.

create_input.session_material: The endpoint uses page numbers and assumes a maximum of one hundred records per page.
decisions: Sort by created_at and then stable record ID.

evidence.content: The original API contract exposes integer page and page_size parameters.
The handler applies offset and limit using the supplied page number.
Tests require descending created_at order with ID as the tie breaker.

additional_evidence.content: The accepted API revision replaces page numbers with an opaque next_cursor token.

tasks.continuation_context: The continuation starts before public release, so contract tests may change.

create_input.session_material: The cache currently retains product entries for sixty minutes and the failing test expects five minutes.
constraints: Do not invalidate unrelated cache namespaces.
decisions: Change only the product cache policy.

evidence.content: Product cache entries must expire after five minutes.
test_product_cache_ttl observes a configured TTL of sixty minutes.
Session and catalog caches have separate named policies.

additional_evidence.content: Product management reconfirmed the five-minute product-cache TTL.

tasks.continuation_context: The failing test is isolated and reproducible.

constraint_phrases: Do not invalidate unrelated cache namespaces.

create_input.session_material: The interrupted patch closes the modal by mouse and restores its visual layout.

evidence.content: The close button works with pointer clicks but not the Escape key.
The dialog has no keyboard event handler or focus restoration.
The approved screenshot matches the current spacing and colors.

additional_evidence.content: Acceptance requires Escape to close and focus to return to the trigger.

tasks.continuation_context: Add interaction coverage without redesigning the dialog.

create_input.session_material: The draft migration renames full_name to display_name in one transaction and drops the old column.
constraints: No customer records may be lost.
decisions: Run the change through the normal migration framework.

evidence.content: The original plan renames full_name and immediately drops the old column.
The draft migration contains a destructive DROP COLUMN operation.
The currently deployed application still reads full_name.

additional_evidence.content: Operations approved only an expand-and-contract migration with both columns available during rollout.

tasks.continuation_context: Deployment spans old and new application versions.

constraint_phrases: No customer records may be lost.

create_input.session_material: A reproducible test shows that records near midnight are assigned to the wrong local day.
decisions: Convert to the account timezone only at the reporting boundary.

evidence.content: test_daily_summary_boundary fails for 23:30 UTC in an Asia/Tokyo account.
The query truncates the UTC timestamp before applying the account timezone.
Persistent timestamps use UTC across the service.

additional_evidence.content: Reporting owners confirmed that day boundaries follow the account timezone.

tasks.continuation_context: The test can be extended with both sides of midnight.

create_input.goal: Complete request logging for the account lookup endpoint.
create_input.session_material: The current patch logs the full account email to make lookup failures searchable.
constraints: Keep enough context to correlate failures across services.

evidence.content: The original observability note asks for the complete account email in every failure log.
The patch emits account_email without redaction.
A generated correlation ID already crosses the involved services.

additional_evidence.content: The privacy review prohibits email addresses in logs and requires correlation IDs instead.

tasks.continuation_context: The log schema may change before release.

constraint_phrases: Keep enough context to correlate failures across services.

create_input.goal: Finish bounded retries for the upstream inventory client.
create_input.session_material: The client retries transient gateway failures twice with exponential backoff but does not handle Retry-After.
constraints: Never retry authentication or validation failures.
decisions: Allow at most two retries after the first request.

evidence.content: The client retries HTTP 502 and 503 twice with exponential backoff.
Tests cover bounded 503 retries and immediate 401 failure.
Authentication and validation failures are non-retryable.

additional_evidence.content: The provider documents Retry-After for HTTP 429 and requires clients to cap the delay at thirty seconds.

tasks.continuation_context: Add deterministic retry tests without real sleeping.

constraint_phrases: Never retry authentication or validation failures.
